verdict.rationale: WezTerm's docs show color-scheme support: the homepage advertises 'true color and dynamic color schemes', and the config docs mention changing the color scheme. Nothing in the pack documents automatic light/dark switching tied to the OS appearance, so only the first half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented automatic light/dark mode switching, in-depth color-scheme/theme documentation (e.g., a built-in scheme catalog), and independent hands-on corroboration of theming.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can apply color schemes and themes, including automatic light/dark mode switching

citations.quote: Ligatures, Color Emoji and font fallback, with true color and dynamic color schemes.
